newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil is not considering telecom rate hike -Motta.
newsitem.headline: Brazil is not considering telecom rate hike -Motta.

text.p: The Brazilian government does not intend to authorize a telecommunications rate increase, Communications Minister Sergio Motta said.
"We are not discussing changes in the rates," Motta told a seminar on the privatization of the telecommunications sector.
Motta said the government was working on an ongoing process to eliminate cross subsidies from the telecommunications rate structure.
Market traders have been speculating that the government would announce a telecommunications rate hike any time soon as a prior step to the privatization of the Telebras system.
The last rate adjustment was in November 1995.
Motta said, however, the government was seeking to establish "true" rate levels for different services in the telecommunications industry in the run-up to the privatization of the telecom sector.
